meta.title: Lba Rda An Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the LBA Capital Projects Fund Budget resolution to a future meeting for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the Local Building Authority Capital Projects Fund budget for FY 2023-24, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries, and defers formal adoption to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adjourn the Local Building Authority meeting and reconvene as the Redevelopment Agency.
votes.description: Formally adjourns the LBA session and transitions the board into its role as the Redevelopment Agency board.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer the RDA Budget resolution to a future meeting for action.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the Redevelopment Agency of Salt Lake City budget for FY 2023-24 and defers adoption to a future meeting.
Formally adjourns the RDA board session.

votes.motion: Approve the Formal Minutes for April 4, 2023.
votes.description: Approves the official formal meeting minutes of the City Council session held on April 4, 2023.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Cannon Greens Community Garden lease resolution to a future meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a resolution authorizing below-market rent leases to the International Rescue Committee and Wasatch Community Gardens for 2.41 acres at 1300 South and 800 West for urban farming, deferring adoption to a later date.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Housing SLC five-year housing plan ordinance to a later date.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on an ordinance adopting the new five-year moderate income housing plan 'Housing SLC,' replacing the expiring 'Growing SLC' plan, and defers final adoption.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Salt Lake School District Signs ordinance to a future meeting.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a zoning text amendment to Section 21A.46.052 allowing pole signs on school properties in various zoning districts, deferring adoption to a later meeting.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on the Airport Revenue Bonds resolution to June 13, 2023 due to a noticing error.
votes.description: Continues the public hearing on a parameters resolution authorizing up to $600 million in Airport Revenue Bonds Series 2023 for SLC International Airport capital improvements to the next meeting due to a noticing error.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items G-5 through G-12 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: Closes the combined public hearing on eight grant applications (including transportation, youth services, victim advocacy, parks, and energy grants) and refers them to a future consent agenda for formal approval.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on ordinances G-13 through G-24 (FY 2023-24 budget-related ordinances) to a future meeting.
votes.description: Closes the combined public hearing on FY 2023-24 budget implementation ordinances including the Library Fund budget, City budget, tax levy, fee schedule, compensation plan, union MOUs, and various code amendments, deferring adoption to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 23 of 2023 approving various changes to the Salt Lake City Code relating to early notification of the public and recognized community organizations for land use projects.
votes.description: Adopts a zoning code text amendment clarifying early notification regulations and public outreach requirements for various types of City land use projects to increase public awareness and participation.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 24 of 2023 amending zoning text of various sections of Title 21A pertaining to building heights in the Downtown Plan area; and adopt a legislative action initiating a petition to study bird-friendly glass and provide recommendations on best practices for its use.
votes.description: Adopts zoning text amendments to multiple downtown and gateway zoning districts addressing building heights, street activation, and public space standards, and initiates a study petition on bird-friendly building glass.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 25 of 2023 amending the final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document for FY 2022-23 for items A-1, A-4 through A-8, A-10, A-12 through A-14, D-2 through D-10, E-1, E-2, and G-1 as shown on the motion sheet.
votes.description: Approves Budget Amendment No. 6 for FY 2022-23 covering numerous adjustments including Cultural Core funding, Liberty Park fountain rescope, open space acquisitions, Steiner Aquatics roof replacement, ARPA revenue replacement, flood mitigation, and various departmental transfers and grants.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 25 of 2023 amending the FY 2023 final budget including the employment staffing document for item A-15 (ARPA Funding to Perpetual Housing Fund External Developer, $10 million from ARPA), as a contingent appropriation subject to Council approval of a term sheet.
votes.description: Approves a $10 million ARPA-funded contingent appropriation to the Perpetual Housing Fund of Utah as part of Budget Amendment No. 6, conditioned on Council approval of a term sheet before funds are released.

votes.motion: Approve items L1 through L8 from the consent agenda.
votes.description: Approves a block of consent items including setting public hearing dates for four rezoning/text amendment ordinances, approving Grant Holding Account Batch No. 10, and confirming two board appointments and one reappointment.

votes.motion: Approve item L9 from the consent agenda (setting public hearing date for rezone at approximately 1350, 1358, and 1370 South West Temple).
votes.description: Sets the public hearing date of July 11, 2023 to consider a rezone of properties at 1350, 1358, and 1370 South West Temple from RB to TSA-UC-C to facilitate mixed-use redevelopment; Council Member Mano recused himself.
